title: Death Benefit Settlement Figures for Ashgrove Income Annuities Tiers
content:
Four tier figures of Income Annuities govern how amounts owed after an annuitant's death are settled: whether a beneficiary may commute the remaining certain payments, the commutation discount spread, the fewest remaining payments for which commutation is offered, and the death-claim interest rate.

| Tier | Beneficiary may commute remaining certain payments | Commutation discount spread | Fewest remaining certain payments for commutation | Death-claim interest rate (annual, simple) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Life Only | No | 1% (0.0100) | 12 | 3.5% (0.035) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Cash Refund | No | 1% (0.0100) | 12 | 3.5% (0.035) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity 10-Year Certain | Yes | 1% (0.0100) | 12 | 3.5% (0.035) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity 20-Year Certain | Yes | 1% (0.0100) | 12 | 3.5% (0.035) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 50% Survivor | No | 1% (0.0100) | 12 | 3.5% (0.035) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 100% Survivor | No | 1% (0.0100) | 12 | 3.5% (0.035) |

**What each column means.**

1. *Beneficiary may commute* — whether a beneficiary may take the commuted value of the remaining certain payments in one sum. Only the two period-certain tiers allow it.
2. *Commutation discount spread* — the addition to the contract's pricing interest rate used to discount remaining certain payments. The figure is the same on every tier; it is relevant in practice on the tiers that allow commutation.
3. *Fewest remaining certain payments* — commutation is offered only while at least 12 certain payments remain.
4. *Death-claim interest rate* — the annual rate of simple interest on lump-sum death benefits from the date due proof is received to payment.

**Points of reading (hypothetical).**

- With 12 certain payments remaining on a 10-Year Certain contract, the figure of 12 is met; with 11 remaining it is not.
- A contract priced at a pricing interest rate of 4.00% shows, with the 1% commutation discount spread, a combined rate of 5.00%.
- On a lump-sum death benefit of $10,000.00, 3.5% simple interest for 73 days over 365 is $70.00.
